toolsPreview.name: environment_near
toolsPreview.description: Federal environmental records within a radius of a US location: Superfund/NPL sites, TRI toxic-release facilities, and facilities currently flagged for significant noncompliance. Pass EITHER a street address (geocoded via the US Census geocoder) OR lat/lon coordinates.

toolsPreview.name: drinking_water
toolsPreview.description: Public water systems serving a US state + county and/or city, with health-based SDWA violation summaries. Matching is approximate (service boundaries are not public); the user's water bill names their actual utility.

toolsPreview.name: due_diligence
toolsPreview.description: Address due-diligence layer scores for a US location: school quality, natural hazards, groundwater contamination, Superfund proximity, air quality, highway noise, walkability, crime, and climate pleasantness (pleasant days/year). Scores are 0-1 with 1.0 = favorable; null = cannot score that layer here. no_coverage flags placeholder values machine-readably; relay caveats verbatim. Coverage: environmental layers CA/Bay Area, schools 20 states, climate CA statewide. Pass EITHER a street address (geocoded via the US Census geocoder) OR lat/lon coordinates.
